steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Didn't think I would ever see you surprised like this.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I gave you a hint, after all.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That rock? Very funny.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I thought...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Who did you think would come? Manfred?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm thinking Theresis must be getting senile if he let you live. You even get to roam around Londinium like this?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I thought you guys were long dead, since I haven't heard anything from you in ages.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Well... you know what they say about assuming? See, you were right. I've become sentimental, almost forgot we're mercs.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Your detonator hand slowed down, W.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And your hand isn't trembling this time.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What about those mercenaries you brought from Reunion? Did you really come alone?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Why would I bring them? So that they could get bought out by the Regent, like you?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Looks like you care about them. No wonder I didn't see any familiar faces.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Speak for yourself. I saw lots of old friends in Londinium.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You really like headhunting under my nose, don't you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Let me guess, Schwab is dead, isn't he? You killed him, didn't you, Hoederer? He knew you longer than he knew me, right?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Did your hand tremble when you killed an old friend? One who carried you on his back for an entire day, dodging dozens of Theresis's killers?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're remembering it wrong. He was gone by the Battle for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Alright, you've always had a better memory than me for the people we fought with.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I've always wanted to ask... does it make you feel better to remember the dead?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I don't think so. I can see it in your eyes. Your dreams haunt you now more than ever.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I've known you for as long as you've known me.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're only trying to hide your own feelings when move to provoke me like that.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ha, like you'd know.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: In the old days, you would have thrown out those useless resistance fighters as bait.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: If someone told me that W volunteered to be the rear guard, I would have told them to find a funnier joke.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Did your time in Chernobog drive you mad, W?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Did Talulah burn your brains out, or are you seeing the shadows of the dead?

steps.name: W
steps.text: The mad never admit their madness, right? How do you know I'm the one who's mad?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Schwab's head isn't enough to buy Theresis's trust. What was the price you had to pay?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Could it have been her? Don't tell me...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Don't even say it.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh? There's a reaction.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We've done all we could.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You were too slow, W.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Did I hear that right? Are you looking for an excuse for your screw-ups? Who was it who told me he had a plan for everything?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: When do you think I lost my eye?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You don't mean that Ines...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Yes, she's dead.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Again?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm not...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Mercenaries pay a price for breaching trust. I've paid mine.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We're out.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: We've been lucky, haven't we?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: The Sarkaz got drawn to the explosions in the south. The ones guarding the interrogation room got taken out by Dublinn.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Nothing good comes of relying on luck in battle.
Ha. Did you think you would have lived this long, if not for lady luck?

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: W-Who's she? Did they escape from the interrogation room too? Are they friends?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Enemies.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (Aim.)

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (But hold your fire.)

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Can't talk without your crossbow raised, soldier? Don't think I didn't know you only got out by following us.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You want me to thank you? Then you'd better take a trip with me to the hardest prison in Londinium.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I'll give you credit.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You're not like the nobles that seep oil from every pore.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: They're the ones who kneel before anyone to cling to their way of life. Sarkaz or Dublinn... it makes no difference to them.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You, though... you just won't give up. You're like flies, getting in my way no matter where I go.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's my line.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Why you...!
*Cough* *cough* Mandragora...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Your friend's in pretty bad shape.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Same to those soldiers behind you.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Looks like we're both in a hurry.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: It's a shame that I don't have time for you today.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Suits me just fine.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Make way.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: By the way, soldier—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You had better not die at the hands of the Sarkaz...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Before I have the chance to impale you with my rock.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Whew... they're gone.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good. Save your ammo for the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Do you mean...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't you think it's too easy?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Whoever Dublinn took from the interrogation room, I doubt the Sarkaz would let them go so easily.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Or us, for that matter.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you have everyone, Lady Heidi?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Yes, Amiya. They're all here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Careful!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let the weakest go first. We'll take care of any pursuing mercenaries.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Feist, can you still fight?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hang on tight, Bill. Things could get bumpy.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: More enemies ahead! They must have come in from another entrance!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Target found!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Over here! Get them!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hey, don't run too fast. Got to keep a pair of eyes in the back of your head when moving.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: A few got away.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Still not enough?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Get that caster first. Don't let him cast any Arts on our wounded.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank goodness you are back.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: We aren't late to the party, are we?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Whew... Doctor, you didn't tell me there was only one fighter meeting up with us.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You know, Doctor, the more I learn about Rhodes Island, the more mysterious it seems.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: But at the end of the day, the most mysterious one is always you.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You always have a card up your sleeve, don't you?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: On this point, we're the same.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: It looks like the Sarkaz have been drawn over here. But we didn't see many souls on the way.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The ones holding off the enemies inside... I'm worried about them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm worried about W...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: W? The one who made such an impression on all those operators at Chernobog?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Er, yeah.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Rhodes Island really IS filled with talent.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have a... temporary understanding.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I felt something eerie in her gaze when she said she was looking for Lady Heidi.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Her emotions can be unusual, but there are times that she doesn't try to hide them. Her eyes don't lie at times like that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The last time I saw that look from her was when she was yelling at me for the codes to stop the core city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is she still hiding something?

options: Ask her when she comes back.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Alright... I trusted her once, I'll trust her again.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Huff... huff...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're bleeding a lot.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You've got a few holes in you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You should have hidden another bomb on yourself, like you used to. That way, you'd at least have a chance to take me down with you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: *Cough*... Hoederer...

steps.name: W
steps.text: How much is my head worth? Enough to buy a small house in Londinium?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sorry, W. The Regent has better things to do than remember the name of a random merc.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ha... did you say that to Ines too? Before she gave her life for your little dream?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Still talking big, eh?

steps.name: W
steps.text: What were you expecting? A big laugh and a standing ovation for your dumb shit? No tears on my face, Hoederer. That's not like me.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Who's the dumb one? You're on the ground, not me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Like I said, I'm just... a little surprised.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So surprised you missed multiple chances to maim me?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Now that's not like you, W. What made you lose your cool?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Let's see... how about an old friend coming back from the dead and trying to put his sword through me?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I can believe that.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W... who is this old friend you're talking about?

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's what I don't like about you... You always think you can see right through me, same as her.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Too bad for you, I'm right again.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It's been a while since you snuck into Londinium. There aren't too many distractions like this in here. What did you see in the city?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're the one following Theresis, not me. Have you not kowtowed to his traitor throne enough times? Still can't see through his tricks?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So you knew.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Stop playing this game of you-know I-know. Look like a mercenary for once, Hoederer.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I can't let you leave here alive, W.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Of all the old friends that I've killed... you're probably the one who could best understand the choice I'm making.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Now who's indecisive?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm not taking my eyes off you. I want to see the Sarkaz who had the nerve to put his sword through me.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Alright then.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Goodbye, W.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Something deflected my sword... a dagger? Where did it come from?
Don't move.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It's been a long time, Ascalon.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Same to you. Don't move.

steps.name: W
steps.text: *Cough* Or what?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wait, you came to save me, right?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't tell me you came to help him? Don't you know what Theresis did to her—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Maybe work on your aim? I just barely dodged that, what with my injuries and all.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Too bad.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You know you can't kill me now, right?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You've been my boss, and I've been yours. But there's someone here who's been boss to both of us. And she's clearly not in a good mood.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I know. Our heads could drop off our shoulders at any moment.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I have nothing else to say.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Each word will make you bleed a little faster.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I know, thanks for the concern.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Looks like you'll have to accept a little failure if you don't want to die here together, 'Captain' Hoederer.
